body: &str,\n    req: &str,\n    sessions: &mut HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> (u16, String) {\n    match path {\n        \"/v1/storage/reset\" => {\n            if let Err(e) = reset_db() {\n                eprintln!(\"reset storage failed: {}\", e);\n                (500, r#\"{\"error\":\"reset failed\"}\"#.to_string())\n            } else {\n                sessions.clear();\n                // Preserve registered user accounts across storage reset so that\n                // the authenticated play surface can still identify DMs/players\n                // established earlier in the cumulative test suite.\n                (200, r#\"{\"ok\":true,\"schema_version\":1}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n        }\n        \"/v1/auth/register\" => match auth::handle_register(body, users) {\n            Ok(resp) => {\n                let _ = save_storage(sessions, users);\n                (201, resp)\n            }\n            Err(auth::RegisterError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate username\"}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n            Err(auth::RegisterError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/auth/login\" => match auth::handle_login(body, users) {\n            Ok(resp) => (200, resp),\n            Err(auth::LoginError::Unauthorized) => (401, r#\"{\"error\":\"unauthorized\"}\"#.to_string()),\n            Err(auth::LoginError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/dice/stats\" => option_response(dice::handle_dice_stats(body)),\n        \"/v1/checks/ability\" => option_response(dice::handle_ability_check(body)),\n        \"/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp\" => option_response(encounters::handle_encounter(body)),\n        \"/v1/initiative/order\" => option_response(combat::handle_initiative(body)),\n        \"/v1/characters/ability-modifier\" => option_response(phb::handle_long_rest(body)),\n        \"/v1/phb/equipment-load\" => option_response(phb::handle_equipment_load(body)),\n        \"/v1/combat/sessions\" => match combat::create_session(body, sessions) {\n            Some(resp) => {\n                let _ = save_storage(sessions, users);\n                (200, resp)\n            }\n            None => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/compendium/monsters\" => match compendium::handle_create_monster(body) {\n            Ok(resp) => (201, resp),\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate slug\"}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::NotFound) => (404, NOT_FOUND.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/compendium/items\" => match compendium::handle_create_item(body) {\n            Ok(resp) => (201, resp),\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate slug\"}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::NotFound) => (404, NOT_FOUND.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/play/campaigns\" => match require_auth(req, users, AuthRequirement::Dm) {\n            Ok(owner) => match play::create_play_campaign(body, &owner) {\n                Ok(resp) => {\n                    let _ = save_storage(sessions, users);\n                    (201, resp)\n                }\n                Err(play::PlayError::Conflict) => {\n                    (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate play campaign id\"}\"#.to_string())\n                }\n                Err(play::PlayError::NotFound) => (404, NOT_FOUND.to_string()),\n                Err(play::PlayError::Forbidden) => (403, FORBIDDEN.to_string()),\n                Err(play::PlayError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n            },\n            Err(e) => auth_error(e),\n        },\n        \"/v1/campaigns\" => match campaigns::create_campaign(body) {\n            Ok(resp) => (201, resp),\n            Err(campaigns::CampaignError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate campaign id\"}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n            Err(campaigns::CampaignError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n dispatch_dynamic_post(path, body, req, sessions, users),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Dispatch dynamic POST routes that include path parameters.\nfn dispatch_dynamic_post(\n    path: &str,\n    body: &str,\n         sessions.clear();\n                // Preserve registered user accounts across storage reset so that\n                // the authenticated play surface can still identify DMs/players\n                // established earlier in the cumulative test suite.\n                (200, r#\"{\"ok\":true,\"schema_version\":1}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n        }\n        \"/v1/auth/register\" => enum PlayError {\n    BadRequest,\n    NotFound,\n    Conflict,\n    Forbidden,\n}\n\n/// Parse a non-empty id that follows a fixed prefix and ends with a suffix.\n///\n/// Returns `None` if the id is empty or contains an additional `/` segment.\nfn parse_play_suffix<'a>(path: &'a str, prefix: &'a str, suffix: &'a str) -> Option<&'a str> {\n    let rest = path.strip_prefix(prefix)?;\n    let id = rest.strip_suffix(suffix)?;\n    if id.is_empty() || id.contains('/') {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some(id)\n}\n\n/// Parse a campaign id and a nested sub-resource id from a path.\n///\n/// The path shape is `/v1/play/campaigns/{campaign_id}{marker}{sub_id}{suffix}`.\n/// Both identifiers must be non-empty and must not contain additional segments\n/// before the marker or suffix.\nfn parse_play_nested<'a>(\n    path: &'a str,\n    prefix: &'a str,\n    marker: &'a str,\n    suffix: &'a str,\n) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {\n    let rest = path.strip_prefix(prefix)?;\n    let mid = rest.find(marker)?;\n    let campaign_id = &rest[..mid];\n    if campaign_id.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    let after = &rest[mid + marker.len()..];\n    let sub_id = after.strip_suffix(suffix)?;\n    if sub_id.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some((campaign_id, sub_id))\n}\n\n/// Parse a campaign id and encounter id from an encounter sub-resource path.\nfn parse_play_encounter_base<'a>(path: &'a str, suffix: &'a str) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {\n    parse_play_nested(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", \"/encounters/\", suffix)\n}\n\n/// Parse a campaign id, encounter id, and a final resource id from an encounter\n/// resource path such as `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/encounters/{enc_id}/monsters/{m_id}`.\nfn parse_play_encounter_resource<'a>(\n    path: &'a str,\n    resource: &'a str,\n) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str, &'a str)> {\n    let (campaign_id, after) = parse_play_nested(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", \"/encounters/\", \"\")?;\n    let marker = format!(\"/{}/\", resource);\n    let mid = after.find(&marker)?;\n    let encounter_id = &after[..mid];\n    let resource_id = &after[mid + marker.len()..];\n    if encounter_id.is_empty() || resource_id.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some((campaign_id, encounter_id, resource_id))\n}\n\n/// Parse a play campaign id from a path like `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/members`.\npub fn parse_play_campaign_path<'a>(path: &'a str, suffix: &'a str) -> Option<&'a str> {\n    parse_play_suffix(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", suffix)\n}\n\n/// Create a new play campaign.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns\n///\n/// The body must contain non-empty `id` and `name` and a positive\n/// `max_players`. {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if !play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, _phase, _turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let (character_id, character_name) =\n        play_campaign_member_character(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let narrations = play_campaign_narrations(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    let is_my_turn = current_actor == actor;\n    let mut events_json = Vec::new();\n    for (sequence, kind, event_actor, text) in narrations {\n        events_json.push(format!(\n            r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"{}\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"text\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n            sequence,\n            escape_json(&kind),\n            escape_json(&event_actor),\n            escape_json(&text)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"is_my_turn\":{},\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"character\":{{\"id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\"}},\"recent_events\":[{}]}}\"#,\n        is_my_turn,\n        escape_json(&current_actor),\n        escape_json(&character_id),\n        escape_json(&character_name),\n        events_json.join(\",\")\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read the GM turn status for a play campaign.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/gm/status\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may read this endpoint. -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, phase, turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if current_actor != \"dm\" || (phase != \"dm\" && phase != \"exploration\") {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if members.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let next_index = (turn_number % members.len() as i64) as usize;\n    let next_actor = members[next_index].0.clone();\n    let new_turn_number = turn_number + 1;\n\n    let sequence = play_narration_next_sequence(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"resolution\", \"dm\", text)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_update_turn(campaign_id, &next_actor, \"player\", new_turn_number)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"resolution\",\"actor\":\"dm\",\"text\":\"{}\",\"next_actor\":\"{}\",\"turn_number\":{}}}\"#,\n        sequence,\n        escape_json(text),\n        escape_json(&next_actor),\n        new_turn_number\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Parse a play campaign scene sub-resource path.\n///\n/// For example, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/scenes/{scene_id}/enter` The body names a skill,\n/// an ability, whether the character is proficient, and the raw d20 roll. The\n/// response reports the computed modifier and the total roll + modifier.\n/// Unsupported skills or abilities return 400.\npub fn skill_check(\n    campaign_id: &str,\n    character_id: &str,\n    body: &str,\n    actor: &str,\n) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if !play_campaign_character_id_exists(campaign_id, character_id)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?\n    {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let owner = \"proficient\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let roll = extract_int(body, \"roll\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    if !valid_skill(&skill) || !valid_ability(&ability) {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n    if roll < 1 || roll > 20 {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let (str, dex, con, int, wis, cha, level) =\n        play_campaign_member_get_abilities(campaign_id, character_id)\n            .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let ability_score = match ability {\n        \"str\" => str,\n        \"dex\" => Defaults to `game.db` in the working\n/// directory.\npub fn db_path() -> String {\n    env::var(\"DB_PATH\").unwrap_or_else(|_| \"game.db\".to_string())\n}\n\n/// Escape a single quote for safe concatenation into SQLite string literals.\n///\n/// This application builds SQL by string concatenation rather than using\n/// parameterized queries, so every user-supplied string must be escaped before\n/// being embedded in a SQL statement.\npub fn sql_escape(s: &str) -> String {\n    s.replace('\\'', \"''\")\n}\n\n/// Execute a SQL script against the SQLite database without capturing output.\n///\n/// Returns an error if `sqlite3` cannot be spawned or exits with a non-zero\n/// status.\npub fn sqlite_exec(sql: &str) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut child = Command::new(\"sqlite3\")\n        .arg(db_path())\n        .arg(\"-bail\")\n        .stdin(Stdio::piped())\n        .stdout(Stdio::piped())\n        .stderr(Stdio::piped())\n        .spawn()\n        .map_err(|e| format!(\"sqlite3 spawn failed: {}\", e))?;\n\n    if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {\n        stdin\n            .write_all(sql.as_bytes())\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"sqlite3 stdin write: {}\", e))?;\n    }\n\n    let output = child\n        .wait_with_output()\n        .map_err(|e| format!(\"sqlite3 output: {}\", e))?;\n    if !output.status.success() {\n        return Err(format!(\n            \"sqlite3 error: {}\",\n            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)\n        ));\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Execute a SQL query and return the SQLite JSON-mode result as a string.\n///\n/// The output is produced with `.mode json`, so well-formed results are a JSON\n/// array of objects. Empty results are returned as an empty string.\npub fn sqlite_query(sql: &str) -> Result<String, String> {\n    let input = format!(\".mode json\\n{}\\n\", sql);\n    let mut child = Command::new(\"sqlite3\")\n        .arg(db_path())\n        .stdin(Stdio::piped())\n        .stdout(Stdio::piped())\n        .stderr(Stdio::piped())\n        .spawn()\n        .map_err(|e| format!(\"sqlite3 spawn failed: {}\", e))?;\n\n    if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {\n        stdin\n            .write_all(input.as_bytes())\n            .map_err(|e| format!(\"sqlite3 stdin write: {}\", e))?;\n    }\n\n    let output = child\n        .wait_with_output()\n        .map_err(|e| format!(\"sqlite3 output: {}\", e))?;\n    if !output.status.success() {\n        return Err(format!(\n            \"sqlite3 error: {}\",\n            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)\n        ));\n    }\n    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())\n}\n\n/// 'healthy'\"`. This is used by the startup\n/// migrations to make older schemas forward-compatible without altering\n/// behavior for newly created databases.\nfn add_column_if_missing(table: &str, column: &str, definition: &str) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = format!(\"PRAGMA table_info({});\", table);\n    let output = sqlite_query(&sql)?;\n\n    let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let has_column = extract_objects(content)\n        .into_iter()\n        .filter_map(|o| extract_string(o, \"name\"))\n        .any(|name| name == column);\n    if !has_column {\n        sqlite_exec(&format!(\"ALTER TABLE {} ADD COLUMN {};\", table, definition))?;\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Add missing death-save columns to an existing play_campaign_members table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the death-saves stage lack `status`,\n/// `death_saves_successes`, and `death_saves_failures`. 'healthy'\"`. This is used by the startup\n/// migrations to make older schemas forward-compatible without altering\n/// behavior for newly created databases.\nfn add_column_if_missing(table: &str, column: &str, definition: &str) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = format!(\"PRAGMA table_info({});\", table);\n    let output = sqlite_query(&sql)?;\n\n    let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let has_column = extract_objects(content)\n        .into_iter()\n        .filter_map(|o| extract_string(o, \"name\"))\n        .any(|name| name == column);\n    if !has_column {\n        sqlite_exec(&format!(\"ALTER TABLE {} ADD COLUMN {};\", table, definition))?;\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Add missing death-save columns to an existing play_campaign_members table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the death-saves stage lack `status`,\n/// `death_saves_successes`, and `death_saves_failures`.
